about: Retention verdict of every HTTP path (R07a read-path audit). protected: every YouTube field is checked against its own clock (29 days) before it leaves the server; partial: some fields are not, see gaps; unprotected: none checked; no_youtube_data: only IDs, user work or operational state. A new route needs a review and an entry here.

gaps.G7: Two 28-day literals the retention guard cannot see: the hot_video_inventory view (schema/schema.sql:847, '672:00:00'::interval) and COUNT_FRESH_HOURS = 672 (application/channel_inventory_estimate.py:86). Stricter than 29 days, not a leak.
gaps.G9: Frontend rejects a saved collection page when source_expires_at exceeds checked_at + 28 days; the backend now sends up to 29 days (application/frontend/src/explorer/savedCollections.ts:89). Functional regression of the 29-day change, not a leak.
